criteria.label: CLOSE
similar: Both use blackened textured panels, worn steel frames, and restrained amber edging.
Both pair warm amber indicators with cyan energized accents over dark map imagery.
different: Candidate comparison cards have flatter near-black interiors and sparser detailing than the reference's textured, divided panels.
Candidate bezel highlights are brighter silver, while reference metal is darker and more uniformly patinated.

evidence.observation: Dark patterned resource rail has weathered riveted framing, amber iconography, and cyan meter accents.
Resource rail repeats dark patterned metal, bright worn framing, amber iconography, and cyan accents.
Comparison panel uses brown-black texture, amber inset border, divider rules, and repeated pictograms.

criteria.label: RELATED
similar: Both boards show the same modular HUD families: resource rail, inspector, build kit, status rail, and comparison cards.
Both integrate dark framed overlays with amber and cyan status emphasis over map context.
different: Candidate inspector uses a smaller asset image and sparser capacity treatment than the reference's large detailed asset and segmented bar.
Candidate comparison cards are flat text blocks and omit much of the reference's icon-led breakdown and divider hierarchy.
Candidate long headings wrap or crop more aggressively, reducing hierarchy and legibility.

evidence.observation: Inspector presents a large centered substation, clear capacity line, and six-segment utilization bar.
Inspector preserves framed hierarchy but contains a much smaller pixel-scale substation and sparse meter.
Vertical build palette has two large pictorial cells with a strong cyan selected outline.

criteria.label: CLOSE
similar: Both use an independent centered bottom bar with four horizontally segmented metal controls.
Both highlight the second segment in cyan while inactive segments remain dark gray.
Both have thick industrial chrome framing and a similar overall footprint.
different: Candidate bar is modestly wider and taller, with two-line labels and progress text.
Candidate uses diamond and circular stage markers, while reference uses compact playback glyphs and multipliers.

evidence.observation: Centered four-button strip uses a compact chrome frame, cyan second control, and gray inactive controls.
Centered four-stage strip uses matching chrome, cyan second-stage activation, and visible construction progress/result labels.
